title: Computing Igusa's local zeta functions of univariate polynomials, and linear feedback shift registers
notes: docs/theory/padic_lifting_trees.md. Attaches a tree T(f, l_f) of p-adic root approximations to a univariate f and computes the local zeta function from its generating function. The lifting tree is therefore a known object; the project contribution is its identification with the zero-output subtree of the residual Mealy machine, not the tree itself.
